messages:
maya (infra): Seeing NVLink ECC spike + thermal trips in us-west1-gpu-pool-2. 3 nodes auto-restarted, now 6/12 GPU nodes healthy. High error rate starting ~04:10 UTC. tagging Dedicated pools that might be impacted.
jin (sre): ack. pulling metrics and node logs. any immediate customer impact? :eyes:
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0456 | severity: high | assigned: eng-infra oncall
maya (infra): Early impact: a few p50 latency blips for small-batch hosted and some request queuing on dedicated backends. No data leakage.
samir (eng-runtime): If NVLink is flaring thermal/ECC we should avoid live model transfers across those nodes. Recommend pulling traffic from that pool and failing over to us-east1 reserved capacity.
lee (oncall): Oncall will start controlled cordon/drain on the most noisy nodes. Which node IDs?
maya (infra): Noisy nodes: gpu-node-uw2-07, gpu-node-uw2-09, gpu-node-uw2-11. ECC counts (5m rate):
```promql
sum(rate(nvlink_ecc_errors_total{pool=\"us-west1-gpu-pool-2\"}[5m])) by (instance)
```
maya (infra): returns: gpu-node-uw2-07: 38, 09: 42, 11: 31, others <=3.
jin (sre): Plan: 1) shift routing for non-Dedicated traffic to us-east1 (fast) 2) cordon+drain noisy nodes 3) start replacement/RMA with vendor 4) scale up fallback capacity for Dedicated customers if they fall below SLA.
alex (platform): For routing: we can flip traffic at the smart-router rules with a gradual weight change. I can do a 80->20 rollback window.
samir (eng-runtime): Recommend also disable cross-region prefetches and large model shard moves temporarily to avoid hot KV transfers.
lee (oncall): I'll cordon gpu-node-uw2-07 now, then drain. Command I will run:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-uw2-07
kubectl drain gpu-node-uw2-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --timeout=15m
```
maya (infra): ETA for replacement? Vendor says typical RMA 72h but we have a few hot-spare nodes in us-west1 on different racks we can reprovision.
vendor-rma: Vendor rep here. Please put the failing serials in the RMA ticket and we'll prioritize NBD shipping for hw with thermal sensor flagged.
jin (sre): Temporary capacity: alex, can you spin up 4 extra reserved-ish instances in us-east1 (same instance type) and attach to serving pool? Cost is ok short term.
alex (platform): Spinning 4 nodes now via infra-provision pipeline, will tag as emergency-reserve. Estimated ready in 9 minutes.
samir (eng-runtime): Add this to rollback rules: if us-east1 latency > 40ms p95, revert 50% of traffic back to hosters in place; do not route to spot pools.
lee (oncall): gpu-node-uw2-07 drain started. Evictions in progress (~2 models left). Will force after 10m if pods don't move.
maya (infra): Also noticed `nvlink_adapter_temp_celsius` trending up on same nodes. Likely cooling path issue. Rack-level A/C check in progress.
jin (sre): I'm opening a short maintenance window for us-west1-gpu-pool-2 to avoid surprise autoscaling during drains.
ops-bot: Maintenance window scheduled: us-west1-gpu-pool-2 | 04:30-05:15 UTC | owner: eng-infra
maya (infra): Took a snapshot of pod placements and critical customer mappings before drain. Saved to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident/1765007890/snapshots.json
samir (eng-runtime): We should gate Dedicated customer failing over — notify SEs for any opt-in required. I'll message Customer Success.
lee (oncall): gpu-node-uw2-07 drained, cordon stays. Moving to gpu-node-uw2-09 next.
alex (platform): emergency 4 nodes are ready in us-east1 and attached to the pool. Starting traffic ramp: 0->40% over 5 minutes.
jin (sre): Monitoring: keep watch on token routing errors, queue depth, and p95. PromQL snippets:
```promql
sum(rate(request_queue_length[1m])) by (region)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))
```
maya (infra): Observed reduction in ECC after cordon of 07. 09 still hot.
vendor-rma: Please confirm serials: SN-7G24-09, SN-7G24-11, SN-7G24-07 added to RMA ticket 5543. ETA for replacement node shipment: 48-72h.
jin (sre): Next steps recap:
- alex: keep us-east ramped until replacements arrive
- lee/maya: finish controlled drain and reprovision spares on different racks
- samir: disable cross-region shard movements and inform runtime to avoid hot reassign
- vendor-rma: expedite RMAs
- maya: open post-incident doc with root-cause hypothesis (thermal -> NVLink ECC)
maya (infra): tagging Dedicated customers affected and emailing SEs now. Will follow-up with postmortem draft in #postmortems.
lee (oncall): gpu-node-uw2-09 cordon/drain in progress. Next check-in in 12 minutes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jin (sre): Thanks all. If anything changes ping @jin. I'll keep watch on metrics and can revert router weights if us-east latency degrades.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 updated: severity remains high; current mitigations applied (traffic shift, drains, RMAs).
